ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: The expression pictures a mountain-and-wall barrier with no route through: speakers collide with it, are stopped by it, pass through it, or report it collapsing.
EvidenceBody: Foyan asks, 'What is the silver-mountain, iron-wall barrier?' (如何是銀山鐵壁) and answers, 'originally it is an affair inside one's own house' (元來是自家屋裏事); the same passage says that before he understood, it was like this barrier and after understanding, 'originally I am the iron wall' (元來我是鐵壁). Xueyan records cases 'without a route of meaning, like the silver-mountain, iron-wall barrier' (無義路如銀山鐵壁者), and separately quotes Baiyun Duan: an inherited word or half-phrase not yet passed through is like it, while after passage oneself is it. Zhongfeng applies the comparison when the words 'life and death' stop someone and says that 'impermanence of life and death, silver mountain and iron wall' are all present in Zhaozhou's question. A verse records it collapsing under one press (一拶銀山鐵壁摧). The source wording modifies mountain with 'silver' and wall with 'iron,' but the compound's 339 occurrences supply no direct predicate that the mountain is made of silver or the wall made of iron. Corpus controls show that silver and iron can mark actual material elsewhere, appearance elsewhere, and conventional or figurative compounds elsewhere; those separate uses do not decide these modifiers, so the displayed target names only the attested barrier image and does not assign symbolism.

ModifierControls: 銀 verdict in 銀山鐵壁: unresolved modifier inside a figurative barrier image. No direct made-of-silver, casting, melting, color, or appearance predicate governs 銀山 in the compound's 339 occurrences.

鐵 verdict in 銀山鐵壁: figurative-image modifier, not material-attested for this wall. The compound is described as hard (堅), collided with, stopping passage, penetrated, and collapsing, but never as a wall cast or made from iron.

Material controls remain separate: 金佛、銀佛、銅佛、鐵佛 lists physical image materials; 鐵牛 has direct casting frames. Appearance controls such as snow making a silver world, and closest compounds 銀盌、銀籠、鐵牛、鐵漢、鐵蛇、鐵額, cannot donate their modifier relation to 銀山鐵壁.

Silver.MaterialControls: 銀佛 2/1; 銀鑄 1/1 is an appearance comparison ('as if cast in silver'), not construction evidence for 銀山; no 鑄銀, 銀造, 銀熔, or 銀鎔 hits.
Silver.AppearanceControls: 銀色 37/28, 白銀 124/78, 如銀 161/97, 似銀 40/36; a snow sermon says the world becomes silver (混沌銀成世界), but no such appearance predicate modifies 銀山 in this compound.
